Lead a German panzer platoon through the chaos of World War II in this definitive version of the intense, anime-inspired tank simulation. Assemble an elite crew, deploy legendary tanks, and survive fierce engagements where cunning and skill will decide victory or defeat.

Coming to PlayStation 5 in 2026!

Step into a world on the brink of collapse in GreedFall: The Dying World.

Set three years before the original game, this prequel follows the journey of a Teer Fradi native torn from their homeland and taken to the war-torn continent of Gacane. Your personal quest for freedom will challenge a man's ambition to control the world.

Explore breathtakingly diverse landscapes, from the spiritual wilds of Teer Fradee to the baroque city of Peren and ancient coastal ruins. Navigate the intricate politics of warring factions and forge your own destiny.

GreedFall: The Dying World is available for pre-order on PlayStation 5.
